name: Since November
source:
What are you doing with your time on Earth?

Are you happy?

Stay inside.

We have pizza.

[From [url=https://keithballard.itch.io/since-november]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你拿活在世上的這段時間做了些什麼？

你快樂嗎？

在屋裡待著吧。

我們有披薩。

［摘自[url=https://keithballard.itch.io/since-november]Itch.io[/url]］
